procedural_matters: GER 220411 was represented by Pia Christin Conradi.
The race committee was represented by Jorg Taulet.
Ben Kappelaar attended the hearing as an observer.
Both the race committee and GER 220411 provided video evidence during the hearing.
facts: During the startingprocedure U flag has been displayed.
There were no boats in the triangle formed by the ends of the startingline and the first mark during the last minute before the starting signal.
conclusions: By not scoring any UFDs in race 6P, when there were no boats in the triangle, the race committee complied with RRS 30.3.
There wasneither an improper action nor improper omission of the race committee. Therefore, the requirements for redress in RRS 61.4(b)(1) are not met.
